issue.title: Add unit tests for exceptions in GCP gen. ai operators
issue.body:
### Body

Currently the GCP gen. ai operators (`providers/google/src/airflow/providers/google/cloud/operators/gen_ai.py`) are lacking unit tests for exceptions - it would be great if someone could add some.

### Committer

- [x] I acknowledge that I am a maintainer/committer of the Apache Airflow project.

comments.body: I’d like to take this up and start by adding unit tests for one or two GenAI operatores.

> I’d like to take this up and start by adding unit tests for one or two GenAI operatores.

Thank you! Please be sure not to collide with current efforts in #61253 (avoid implementing for `GenAIGeminiCreateBatchJobOperator`)

I added unit tests for validation in `GenAIGenerateContentOperator` 
(missing `project_id` / `location`), avoiding `GenAIGeminiCreateBatchJobOperator` as requested.
PR: #61262.

The validation-focused unit tests for `GenAIGenerateContentOperator` make sense as a starting point, and it’s good to see #61253 being avoided as requested. I’ll take a look at PR #61262.

If more coverage is needed later (e.g. execution paths or error handling for other GenAI operators), I’d be happy to help with reviews or additional tests.

As apparently I've made a mistake and the tests actually exist:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/providers/google/tests/unit/google/cloud/operators/test_gen_ai.py#L142

I'm shifting this task towards testing the raised exceptions (which are currently not tested).

@rutiktambe You may test the exceptions of any operator of your choice - please write it down here as a comment before doing that, so @KL-2300032590 will be able to work on another operator in parallel.

@shahar1 I’ll take up exception testing for GenAIGeminiListBatchJobsOperator. I’ll add tests covering the raised exception and invalid parameter paths so others can continue with different operators in parallel.

PR opened for this: https://github.com/rutiktambe/airflow/pull/1
It adds exception-path tests for GenAIGeminiListBatchJobsOperator covering hook failure/error propagation cases. Please let me know if you’d like additional exception scenarios covered.
I'll take up exception testing for GenAICountTokensOperator. I'll add tests covering raised exceptions when the hook fails.

I have added unit tests for exception handling for the remaining operators and have left out the others being worked on:

- GenAIGenerateContentOperator
- GenAIGeminiListBatchJobsOperator
- GenAICountTokensOperator

I missed the lates comments on this PR, apologies for that:
@rutiktambe please note the you opened the PR on your Airflow fork (`rutiktambe/airflow`), it should be targeted this repository (`apache/airflow`) 
I'll merge @dv-gorasiya 's PR and then @ytoprakc 's (please handle conflicts if there are ).
Afterwards I'll close this issue - contributors who are interested in contributing additional tests could do that out of this issue's scope.
Thank you!

Hi, I would like to contribute to this issue by adding exception tests for one of the remaining Gen AI operators that hasn't been covered yet. I'll make sure to avoid operators that others are already working on. Please let me know if that works. Thanks!
